corner.label: Language and theme
corner.languageHeld: Finish or go back to the first step to change the language.
corner.languageHeldSetup: Finish this step to change the language.

form.offline: You are offline. Reconnect to continue.

password.label: Password
password.invisible: The password has an invisible character, such as a direction mark pasted from a chat. Remove it and type it again.

totp.label: Authenticator code
totp.required: Enter the 6-digit code from your app.

recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.required: Enter one of your recovery codes.
recovery.invalid: That recovery code is not correct, or was already used.

fields.remember: Keep me signed in for 30 days

strength.label: Password strength
strength.weak: Try a longer password, or a few unrelated words.
strength.advisory: This is only a guide. The server makes the final check.

resend.smsDown: Text messages are unavailable right now. The code you have still works.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your mobile number to continue.
login.smsDown: SMS codes cannot be sent right now. Sign in with your password.

otpPhone.description: We will send a 6-digit code to this number.

otpCode.title: Enter the code
otpCode.descriptionGeneric: If the number has an account, a 6-digit code was sent to it.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works only once.
twoFactor.expires: This step ends in {seconds, number} s.

passkeyStep.title: Use your passkey
passkeyStep.description: Follow the prompt from your browser or device to confirm it is you.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Enter your mobile number. We will send you a code to confirm it.
register.closedText: New accounts cannot be created right now.
register.smsDown: Registration needs a text message, and text messages cannot be sent right now. Try again later.
register.confirmDescriptionGeneric: If the number can be used, a 6-digit code was sent to it.
register.noPassword: Without a password you can sign in only with a text message. If text messages stop working, you will not be able to sign in.

invite.title: Join with an invite
invite.subtitle: Enter the invite code you were given.
invite.lookupText: This invite is for the number <tech>{phone}</tech>. It is valid until {date}.
invite.invalidText: The code may be wrong, already used or expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite.smsDown: Text messages cannot be sent right now, so this invite cannot be confirmed. Ask your administrator to create your account instead.
invite.confirmDescription: We sent a 6-digit code to the number <tech>{phone}</tech>.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your mobile number. We will send you a code.
forgot.unavailableText: Text messages cannot be sent right now. Contact your administrator for help.
forgot.codeDescription: If the number has an account, a 6-digit code was sent to it.
forgot.newDescription: After this, all your sessions end and you sign in again.
forgot.totpDescription: Your account also needs the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
forgot.passkeyText: A passkey protects your account. Use it to confirm it is you.
forgot.passkeyInvalid: Your passkey could not confirm it is you. Try again, or choose "I lost my passkey".
forgot.passkeyLostWarning: You can set a new password without the passkey, but signing in with a password stays blocked for 72 hours. Signing in with your passkey in that time ends the wait.
forgot.doneText: All your sessions were ended. Sign in with your new password.
forgot.doneDeferred: Signing in with your password starts in 72 hours. Until then, sign in with your passkey.

changePassword.title: Set a new password
changePassword.subtitle: You must change your password before you continue.
changePassword.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
changePassword.lostAuthenticator: Lost your authenticator? Sign out, then use Forgot Password with a recovery code.

reauth.text: To keep your account safe, enter your current password too. If an administrator made you a one-time password, enter that.
reauth.invalid: The current password is not correct.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.text: You cannot use Ctrl Z until the suspension is lifted. Contact your administrator for details.
